panel.title: Artifacts

dirHintTooltip.assets: UI assets (icons, images, SVGs). Automatically mirrored to codebase/public/ and referenced in generated code. Subdirectories allowed for grouping (e.g. icons/, images/). Accepted: .png .jpg .gif .svg .webp .ico
dirHintTooltip.sources: Place planning documents here. All files are injected as context into Design, Code, and Plan jobs. Accepted: .md .txt .json .yaml .yml .html .xml .csv
dirHintTooltip.design: System design docs, API contracts, and UI specs (MD, JSON). Generated by the Design Job — also serves as input for the Code Job. You can manually add or edit files here. Accepted: .md .json
dirHintTooltip.evals: Auto-generated quality evaluations for each phase (PRD, UI design, system design, code). Generated by the evaluation system — read-only in practice.
dirHintTooltip.figma: Figma design file configuration. Add Figma URLs here to enable Figma-based design extraction.

dirAccepted.assets: PNG · JPG · GIF · SVG · WebP · ICO
